title: Patch: the Duos fuzz forges prompt answers, sends emotes and tries wrapper-refused bodies

**Issue #1695 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #1695: Patch: the Duos fuzz forges prompt answers, sends emotes and tries wrapper-refused bodies
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The co-op fuzz has only two forgery probes while the 1v1 fuzz has the full set: it never sends a malformed prompt answer inside a duel, never sends an emote even when the duel offers it, and never tries the bodies the co-op wrapper itself refuses — a draw offer sent as a duel action, a duel-level concede, a timeout. After this the co-op gate gets the same three probes, reusing the 1v1 machinery.

## Why

- `probe_duos_state` (`crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`) has only reused-nonce and wrong-seat probes.
- `malformed_answers` is `pub` in the engine's testkit and operates on a `GameState` — each duel is one — so it ports directly, wrapped in `DuosActionBody::Duel` for the prompt holder's seat.
- `Duel{Emote}` is filtered out by `AI_SKIPPED_ACTIONS` yet is legal whenever `emotes_heard` and passes `why_duel_refused`'s fallthrough arm — zero coverage, including its propagation into the four redacted views.
- `why_duel_refused` (`crates/engine/src/duos/legal.rs`) rejects Concede-as-Duel, OfferDraw/AnswerDraw, SetAutoEndTurn, Timeout and DisconnectExpired — never forged; `judge_duos_refusal` already exists.

## Proposal

(a) Apply `malformed_answers` to the duel holding the pending prompt, wrapped for its seat; (b) send `Duel{Emote}` from `duos_endings_action` while the duel lists it (the 1v1 endings channel's pattern); (c) add a rotating probe asserting each wrapper-refused body is refused with state kept.

## Where it lands

`crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`; reuse in `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`; the validator under test is `crates/engine/src/duos/legal.rs`. Spec §13.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Malformed answers inside duels are forged and refused with state unchanged.
- [ ] `Duel{Emote}` is sent when listed and its redaction holds in all four views.
- [ ] Each wrapper-refused body is probed refused with state kept.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --duos` and the duos fuzz tests green.

## Size and risks

Small, ~200 lines. Care picking the right duel and seat for a prompt, and sending emote only while listed. Low risk.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39892325340)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`cargo jackioh fuzz --duos` gets the three probes the 1v1 fuzz has. (a) When the policy answers its duel's open prompt, `malformed_answers` (engine testkit) runs on that duel. Each variant is wrapped in `DuosActionBody::Duel` and sent from its variant's seat in that duel, and each must be refused with no events and the state unchanged. (b) The endings channel sends `Duel{Emote}` from a seat while `duos_legal_actions` lists it. A test with a planted listener card logs an emote, folds the game back and checks all four `duos_view_for` views after it. (c) A rotating `wrapper-refused` probe sends, from the seat that acted, one of the six duel bodies `why_duel_refused` refuses (Concede, OfferDraw, AnswerDraw, SetAutoEndTurn, Timeout, DisconnectExpired). Each must be refused with the state kept. The Duos fuzz tests and `cargo jackioh fuzz --duos` must be green.

## Files to touch

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs` | change | header doc; imports; `WRAPPER_REFUSED_PROBE`, `wrapper_refused_bodies`, `wrapper_refused_body`; `duos_endings_action` (emote, new `seats` parameter) and its call; `probe_duos_state` (wrong-seat `?` becomes `if let`, two new probes); `play_duos_game_from` split out of `play_duos_game_inner`; five tests |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | change | visibility only, inside `#[cfg(test)]`: `mod tests`, `mod fuzz_endings_channel`, `LISTENER`, `install_listener` become `pub(crate)` |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | the `fuzz` row's `--duos` sentences about the probes and the channel |

Do not touch `crates/engine/`: `malformed_answers`, `why_duel_refused` and `DuosInvariantMonitor` are reused as they are. Also leave alone `crates/cards/`, `crates/ai/`, `spec/`, `apps/`, `.github/`, `bot/` and every `Cargo.toml`. No new ruling is needed: the refusals are already B9, B10, B11, B37 and B38 (`crates/engine/src/duos/legal.rs`), the emote is R1127, the malformed answers are §10.6 (#1574), and a refusal keeps the state (§9.3). 1. **`crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`** (test code only). Make four one-word edits and nothing else:

   - line 4052: `mod fuzz_endings_channel {` → `pub(crate) mod fuzz_endings_channel {`
   - line 4076: `const LISTENER` → `pub(crate) const LISTENER`
   - line 4096: `fn install_listener()` → `pub(crate) fn install_listener()`

   - Add `malformed_answers` to the `jackioh_engine::testkit::{…}` import.
   - Add `ENDINGS_ACT_CHANCE` and `MALFORMED_ANSWER_PROBE` to the `crate::fuzz::{…}` import.

3. **`duos_fuzz.rs`, new items placed just above `probe_duos_state`:**
   ```rust
   /// A probe failure's name: a duel body the Duos wrapper refuses whoever sends it (#1695).
   const WRAPPER_REFUSED_PROBE: &str = "wrapper-refused";

   /// The duel bodies Duos refuses before any duel sees them (`why_duel_refused`; B9, B10, B11, B37,
   /// B38), as `seat` would send them: the duel's own concede, a draw offer, a draw answer, R82's
   /// setting turned on, a timeout and an expired disconnect.
   fn wrapper_refused_bodies(seat: DuosSeat) -> Vec<ActionBody> {
       vec![
           ActionBody::Concede,
           ActionBody::OfferDraw,
           ActionBody::AnswerDraw { accept: true },
           ActionBody::SetAutoEndTurn { enabled: true },
           ActionBody::Timeout,
           ActionBody::DisconnectExpired { player: seat.player() },
       ]
   }

   /// The wrapper-refused body the probe after step `step` sends: `wrapper_refused_bodies` in turn,
   /// one per probe, as the wrong-seat probe rotates its seat.
   fn wrapper_refused_body(seat: DuosSeat, step: usize) -> ActionBody {
       let bodies = wrapper_refused_bodies(seat);
       bodies[(step / probe_stride()) % bodies.len()].clone()
   }

   - New signature: `fn duos_endings_action(state: &DuosState, seats: &[DuosSeat], rng: &mut Rng) -> Option<(DuosSeat, DuosActionBody)>`.

   ```rust
   // R1127: a seat emotes only while its duel lists an emote, and the stream is drawn only then, so
   // a game no card hears plays as before.
   let emotes: Vec<(DuosSeat, DuosActionBody)> = seats
       .iter()
       .flat_map(|&seat| {
           duos_legal_actions(state, seat)
               .into_iter()
               .filter(|action| matches!(action, DuosActionBody::Duel { body: ActionBody::Emote { .. } }))
               .map(move |action| (seat, action))
       })
       .collect();
   if !emotes.is_empty() && rng.chance(ENDINGS_ACT_CHANCE) {
       return rng.pick(&emotes).cloned();
   }
   ```
   - Extend the doc comment: `seats` are the seats the game waits on, and the channel also sends an emote while that seat's duel lists one (R1127, #1695).
   - In `play_duos_game_inner`'s loop, change the call to `endings.as_mut().and_then(|rng| duos_endings_action(&state, &seats, rng))`.

5. **`probe_duos_state`.**
   - Keep the reused-nonce block as it is.
   - Replace `let other = *idle.get(…)?;` and the expression after it with `if let Some(&other) = idle.get((step / probe_stride()) % idle.len().max(1)) { … }`. The behaviour must not change except that the function goes on when no seat is idle (during the mulligans).
   - Then add the malformed-answer probe:
   ```rust
   // #1574: the policy's answer to its duel's open prompt, made malformed, each variant from its seat
   // in that duel.
   if let DuosActionBody::Duel { body } = &action.body {
       let duel = action.seat.duel();
       for (variant, player, malformed) in malformed_answers(&state.duels[duel], body) {
           let seat = DuosSeat::of(duel, player);
           let forged = DuosAction {
               seat,
               nonce: format!("duos-fuzz-probe-{step}"),
               body: DuosActionBody::Duel { body: malformed },
           };
           if let Some(wrong) = judge_duos_refusal(state, &probe(state, &forged)) {
               return Some(format!(
                   "{MALFORMED_ANSWER_PROBE} probe after step {step}: {seat} sent the {variant} answer to duel {duel}'s open prompt, and it {wrong}"
               ));
           }
       }
   }
   ```
   - End the function with the wrapper-refused probe:
   ```rust
   // #1695: a duel body the wrapper refuses whoever sends it, from the seat that acted.
   let body = wrapper_refused_body(action.seat, step);
   let forged = DuosAction {
       seat: action.seat,
       nonce: format!("duos-fuzz-probe-{step}"),
       body: DuosActionBody::Duel { body: body.clone() },
   };
   judge_duos_refusal(state, &probe(state, &forged)).map(|wrong| {
       format!(
           "{WRAPPER_REFUSED_PROBE} probe after step {step}: {} sent {} inside its duel, and it {wrong}",
           action.seat,
           body.action_type().as_str()
       )
   })
   ```
   - Rewrite its doc comment to list all four probes in order: reused-nonce, wrong-seat, malformed-answer, wrapper-refused.

6. **Split `play_duos_game_inner`.**
   - Move its whole body into a new `fn play_duos_game_from<F>(seed: u32, options: DuosCreateOptions, probe: DuosReducer, mut tamper: F) -> Result<DuosRun, String>` with the same `where` bound, and delete the line `let options = duos_options_for_seed(seed);`.
   - Its doc comment: "`play_duos_game_inner` from `options` rather than the seed's own: a test plants a card in its decks."
   - `play_duos_game_inner(seed, probe, tamper: F)` becomes the single line `play_duos_game_from(seed, duos_options_for_seed(seed), probe, tamper)`.

7. **Module header of `duos_fuzz.rs`.**
   - Item 4: there are now four probes. Add a malformed-answer probe (the policy's answer made malformed as #1574's 1v1 probe makes it, in that duel, each variant from its seat) and a wrapper-refused probe (one of six duel bodies in turn, from the seat that acted). A failure begins `wrong-seat probe`, `reused-nonce probe`, `malformed-answer probe` or `wrapper-refused probe`.

8. **`crates/tools/README.md`, the `fuzz` row**, in the `--duos` part:
   - After "…and names the step", add: while a duel's prompt is open the policy's answer is also sent malformed, wrapped for each variant's seat in that duel (#1574). In turn, one of the six duel bodies the wrapper refuses is also sent from the seat that acted (#1695). A failure may also begin `malformed-answer probe` or `wrapper-refused probe`.
   - In the channel sentence, add "and, while a seat's duel lists one, that seat's emote (R1127)".

## Tests

All tests go in `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`, `mod tests`.

In `mod duos_probe_stage`, add:
- `fn lenient(state: &DuosState, action: &DuosAction) -> DuosReduceResult`: when `action.body` is `Duel{Answer{..}}`, `state.duels[action.seat.duel()].pending` is `Some(pending)` with `pending.player_id == action.seat.player()`, and `jackioh_engine::prompt_answers(pending)` has a first answer, it calls `duos_reduce` on the action with that first answer as its body. Otherwise it calls `duos_reduce(state, action)`. This is a copy of `fuzz.rs`'s `lenient`.
- `fn wrapperless(…) -> DuosReduceResult`: when `action.body` is `Duel{body}` and `wrapper_refused_bodies(action.seat).contains(body)`, it returns `DuosReduceResult { state: state.clone(), events: Vec::new(), error: None }`. Otherwise it calls `duos_reduce`.
- `const PROMPT_SEEDS: u32 = 12;` and `fn assert_caught_in_some_seed(probe: DuosReducer, name: &str)`: it finds the first seed of `1..=PROMPT_SEEDS` whose `failure_lines(&[fuzz_duos_seed_with(seed, probe, |_, _, _, _| {})])` is non-empty (panicking with the probe's name when there is none) and asserts that the line starts with `format!("seed {seed}: {name} probe after step ")`.
- `a_reducer_that_takes_a_malformed_answer_fails_the_malformed_answer_probe_naming_seed_and_step`: `assert_caught_in_some_seed(lenient, MALFORMED_ANSWER_PROBE)`.
- `a_reducer_that_takes_a_wrapper_refused_body_fails_the_wrapper_refused_probe_naming_seed_and_step`: `assert_caught(wrapperless, WRAPPER_REFUSED_PROBE)`, which is expected to fail seed 7 at step 0.
- `every_wrapper_refused_body_is_refused_from_every_seat_with_the_state_kept`: call `register_all()`, hold `preview_every_set()`'s guard, and take two states, `duos_begin(&duos_create(&duos_options_for_seed(1))).state` (the mulligans) and `jackioh_engine::testkit::duos_scenario("wrapper-refused", duos_decks_for_seed(1), None)` (round 1). For each state, each seat of `DUOS_SEATS` and each body of `wrapper_refused_bodies(seat)`, assert `judge_duos_refusal(state, &duos_reduce(state, &DuosAction { seat, nonce: "wrapper-refused-test".into(), body: DuosActionBody::Duel { body } }))` is `None`.
- `the_wrapper_refused_probe_sends_every_body_in_turn`: `(0..len).map(|probe| wrapper_refused_body(DuosSeat::B2, probe * probe_stride()))` collected equals `wrapper_refused_bodies(DuosSeat::B2)`.

Add a new `mod duos_endings_emote` (`use super::*;`, `crate::fuzz::tests::fuzz_endings_channel::{LISTENER, install_listener}`, `jackioh_engine::testkit::{check_duos_view_redaction, clear_overrides}`, `jackioh_engine::duos_view_for`) with `const EMOTE_SEEDS: u32 = 400;` (the 1v1 channel tests' width) and one test, `a_planted_listener_s_opponent_emotes_through_the_duos_channel_and_all_four_views_hold`. Copy the pattern of `fuzz.rs`'s `a_planted_listener_s_opponent_emotes_through_the_channel_and_the_game_folds_back`:
- Call `install_listener()` and hold `preview_every_set()`'s guard.
- Over `(1..=EMOTE_SEEDS).filter(|s| duos_takes_endings(*s))`, `.find` the first seed whose game emotes. For each seed:
  - Take `duos_options_for_seed(seed)` and set `[0]` of each of `decks.a1`, `a2`, `b1` and `b2` to `LISTENER`. Decks hold no duplicates (§2.6 L3), so there is one listener per deck.
  - Play it with `play_duos_game_from(seed, options, duos_reduce, |_, _, _, _| {})`, then call `check_duos_run` and `check_seed_checkpoint`, each `unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("seed {seed}: {e}"))`.
  - Let `at` be the position of the first log entry whose body is `Duel{Emote{..}}`. If there is none, return `false`.
  - Otherwise fold `run.log[..=at]` with `duos_fold(&DuosReplayInput { options: run.options.clone(), … })`. On the folded state, assert that `check_duos_view_redaction(&duos_view_for(&after, seat))` is empty for every seat of `DUOS_SEATS`. With `sender = run.log[at].seat`, assert `duos_view_for(&after, sender).own.emotes_heard == Some(true)` and `duos_view_for(&after, sender.teammate()).teammate.emotes_heard == Some(true)`. Then return `true`.
- Call `clear_overrides()`, then `assert!(emoted.is_some(), …)`.
- Add a comment that under `cargo test` the monitor already held I6 on every state of the run, since its stride is 1.

No test name may hold an `r<digits>` token (`spec check`).

Commands:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh duos_fuzz::
cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh fuzz_endings_channel
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo jackioh spec check
cargo jackioh fuzz --duos --seeds 200
```

## Done when

- [ ] Malformed answers inside duels are forged from the right seat and refused with the state unchanged; the `lenient` test catches a reducer that takes them.
- [ ] The endings channel sends `Duel{Emote}` only while it is listed; the planted-listener test logs one, folds the game back, and the four views pass redaction.
- [ ] Each of the six wrapper-refused bodies is refused from every seat with the state kept, the probe rotates through all six, and the `wrapperless` test catches a reducer that takes them.
- [ ] The existing `any_seat` and `unguarded` probe tests still name their own probes.
- [ ] Every Duos fuzz test, `fuzz_endings_channel`, rustfmt, clippy, spec check and `fuzz --duos --seeds 200` are green, plus the harness's full list: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] The README and the header doc match the code.

## Risks

- **Stream drift.** The probes draw from no random stream, and the emote draw happens only while an emote is listed, so games where no card hears emotes play exactly as before (the existing seed-search tests keep their seeds). Do not move the emote block above the ceiling or answer draws.
- **Wrong-seat early return.** Left as `?`, the new probes would never run during the mulligans. Step 5's `if let` keeps the old messages and order. `any_seat` is still caught by the wrong-seat probe at step 1: no seat is idle at step 0, and the wrapper refuses every new body for every seat.
- **Seed searches.** If `assert_caught_in_some_seed` finds no seed in 1..=12, or the emote test none in 400, report the failure with its output. Do not lower a check or add `#[ignore]`.
- **Time.** A Duos game takes about 1 s under `cargo test`, and the tools' Duos tests take about 20 s today. The new searches stop at their first hit.
- **Thread-local overrides.** The listener test plays on its own thread, never under rayon, as the 1v1 test does.
- **Hidden information.** The views are only read, and nothing reaches the client.

## Open questions

- §13.6 says a Duos match "relays no emote" (the server), while the engine's `why_duel_refused` lets `Duel{Emote}` through to a round seat when a card hears it (R1127). This task fuzzes what the engine offers, as the issue asks. Whether the engine should refuse emotes in Duos is a separate rules decision for a person. It does not block this build.
- Decisions taken here, with the alternatives rejected:
  - The emote chance reuses `ENDINGS_ACT_CHANCE`; a new Duos constant was rejected.
  - The listener is shared from `fuzz.rs` by making its path `pub(crate)`; a second copy was rejected.
  - Each wrapper-refused body is sent from the acting seat, so only the wrapper can refuse it; a rotating seat was rejected.
  - There is one body per refused action type (`AnswerDraw { accept: true }`, `SetAutoEndTurn { enabled: true }`, the values that would change state); probing both values of each was rejected.
````

## Risks

- **Stream drift.** The probes draw from no random stream, and the emote draw happens only while an emote is listed, so games where no card hears emotes play exactly as before (the existing seed-search tests keep their seeds). Do not move the emote block above the ceiling or answer draws.
- **Wrong-seat early return.** Left as `?`, the new probes would never run during the mulligans. Step 5's `if let` keeps the old messages and order. `any_seat` is still caught by the wrong-seat probe at step 1: no seat is idle at step 0, and the wrapper refuses every new body for every seat.
- **Seed searches.** If `assert_caught_in_some_seed` finds no seed in 1..=12, or the emote test none in 400, report the failure with its output. Do not lower a check or add `#[ignore]`.
- **Time.** A Duos game takes about 1 s under `cargo test`, and the tools' Duos tests take about 20 s today. The new searches stop at their first hit.
- **Thread-local overrides.** The listener test plays on its own thread, never under rayon, as the 1v1 test does.
- **Hidden information.** The views are only read, and nothing reaches the client.

## Done when

- [ ] Malformed answers inside duels are forged from the right seat and refused with the state unchanged; the `lenient` test catches a reducer that takes them.
- [ ] The endings channel sends `Duel{Emote}` only while it is listed; the planted-listener test logs one, folds the game back, and the four views pass redaction.
- [ ] Each of the six wrapper-refused bodies is refused from every seat with the state kept, the probe rotates through all six, and the `wrapperless` test catches a reducer that takes them.
- [ ] The existing `any_seat` and `unguarded` probe tests still name their own probes.
- [ ] Every Duos fuzz test, `fuzz_endings_channel`, rustfmt, clippy, spec check and `fuzz --duos --seeds 200` are green, plus the harness's full list: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] The README and the header doc match the code.

## Risks

- **Stream drift.** The probes draw from no random stream, and the emote draw happens only while an emote is listed, so games where no card hears emotes play exactly as before (the existing seed-search tests keep their seeds). Do not move the emote block above the ceiling or answer draws.
- **Wrong-seat early return.** Left as `?`, the new probes would never run during the mulligans. Step 5's `if let` keeps the old messages and order. `any_seat` is still caught by the wrong-seat probe at step 1: no seat is idle at step 0, and the wrapper refuses every new body for every seat.
- **Seed searches.** If `assert_caught_in_some_seed` finds no seed in 1..=12, or the emote test none in 400, report the failure with its output. Do not lower a check or add `#[ignore]`.
- **Time.** A Duos game takes about 1 s under `cargo test`, and the tools' Duos tests take about 20 s today. The new searches stop at their first hit.
- **Thread-local overrides.** The listener test plays on its own thread, never under rayon, as the 1v1 test does.
- **Hidden information.** The views are only read, and nothing reaches the client.

## Open questions

- §13.6 says a Duos match "relays no emote" (the server), while the engine's `why_duel_refused` lets `Duel{Emote}` through to a round seat when a card hears it (R1127). This task fuzzes what the engine offers, as the issue asks. Whether the engine should refuse emotes in Duos is a separate rules decision for a person. It does not block this build.
- Decisions taken here, with the alternatives rejected:
  - The emote chance reuses `ENDINGS_ACT_CHANCE`; a new Duos constant was rejected.
  - The listener is shared from `fuzz.rs` by making its path `pub(crate)`; a second copy was rejected.
  - Each wrapper-refused body is sent from the acting seat, so only the wrapper can refuse it; a rotating seat was rejected.
  - There is one body per refused action type (`AnswerDraw { accept: true }`, `SetAutoEndTurn { enabled: true }`, the values that would change state); probing both values of each was rejected.
